# qrcode-generator

`qrcode.esm.js` is `dist/qrcode.mjs` of [qrcode-generator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator) 2.0.4
by Kazuhiko Arase, unmodified. MIT licence (stated at the top of the file).
Used for the QR code of a new share's link (`web/static/shares.js`).
The `.d.ts` beside it is ours: the few functions `shares.js` uses, for the check of the JavaScript.
